## The problem

What are you trying to do, and what makes it hard today? For example: "As a support desk user, I can't ... so I have to ..."

## Proposed solution

Describe what you would like FlowDesk to do. Mock-ups or screenshots are welcome.

## Alternatives considered

Other solutions or workarounds you have thought about.

## Who would use it

<!-- Which roles benefit? Tick all that apply. -->

- [ ] admin
- [ ] developer
- [ ] support_desk
- [ ] branch_manager

## Data and security impact

<!--
Optional. Would this need new tables or columns, changes to who can see or edit data (RLS policies),
a new privileged action in the admin-actions Edge Function, or a new environment variable?
-->

## Additional context

Anything else, such as links to similar features in other tools.

## Contributing

- [ ] I would like to work on this myself (see CONTRIBUTING.md).
